Disguised as a [Tanngrisnir](http://www.humanosphere.info/wp-content/uploads/2014/07/realistic-animal-toys-plushies-wood-splitter-lee-creations-2-350x265.jpg), the Nature Goddess trotted gracefully along the game trails in the [Forest of Wrangled Trees](https://i.sli.mg/rsUGic.jpg). Taking note of the fleshy fungal caps growing in the fallen red needles of the twisted trees, organisms she did not directly create, their industriousness gave her an idea. These fungus lived efficiently off of the decaying material of the forest, recycling the bio-matter into useful energy for itself. Any creatures that could thrive here would need a similar mechanism for finding nutrients.

When attempting to create life, it was probably best to start small anyway. [Amintas](https://i.sli.mg/M5CEcq.jpg) looked, by the untrained eye, to be nothing more than forest mushrooms. They did, however, have a primitive tribal culture, which often lead itself into warring factions. They're intelligence was not what Pomme had hoped for, but they were interesting creations nonetheless. One might think they were skiddish, due to their size, but they proved to be bold creatures, attempting to steal items from Pomme and cause mischief towards each other. Little did they understand that their boldness did them no good, for they were more flavorful and nutritious than other fungi growing in their forest.

She had more luck in the Golden Forest, where she brought to life the very leaves of the trees. [Leafies](https://i.sli.mg/zgBKyS.jpg) lived in, on, and from the golden leaves of the golden forest. Frolicking to and fro, the Leafies intelligence was greater than the Amintas, but their focus was severely lacking. Caring only for the joy of flying, their attention was hard to control. The only things that drew their attention away from flying were powerful artifacts or hidden secrets; the intrigue was enough to draw them from their recreating.

Bemused, Pomme left the joyful Leafies and instead wandered through the Forest of Rose Colors. There, a particularly lovely and prolific flower caught her eye. Covering the forest floors, the petals formed a cup which filled with the magical dew given to Ebos by Synthos, and a nectar of its own. It seemed so wasteful to have this resource go unused. Taking a strange amphibious creature from a nearby stream, and giving it a mechanism to drink from the flowers, Pomme created the [Hummers](https://s-media-cache-ak0.pinimg.com/736x/85/f0/d1/85f0d16ed5fd7d663bfea2cd02d63744.jpg). Their wings beat so frantically that their presence created a rhythmic humming sound. As their main diet consisted of the magical dew and sugary nectar of the forest flowers, their bodies were small wells of Savagery. Noting this, Pomme made them difficult to catch, for their own safety.
